text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.decay.de: In minecraft ticks (20 per second on a healthy server or game), the delay between when a queued decay is scheduled and it fired.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.doors.cl: When true, Dimensional Doors will automatically close when the player enters their portal.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.doors.do: Set overrides for enabling/disabling certain doors
A list of block ids for doors. If the door's item id is different than the block id, add that as well.
Enable - Only generate dimensional variants of these doors. Disable - Prevent generating dimensional variants of these doors
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.doors.pl: If enabled, breaking a door in creative mode will spawn a rift
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.dungeons: The depth at which limbo is located. If a Rift reaches any deeper than this while searching for a new destination, the player trying to enter the Rift will be sent straight to Limbo.
The scale of the dispersion when escaping from a pocket or limbo, in blocks/depth. Limbo is treated as depth 50.
When true, debug messages will be printed..
When true, blocks around a growing rift will unravel over time.
The chance that an enderman spawned by a detached rift attacks the closest player.
The chance that an enderman spawns at a detached rift.
When true, shows the bounding boxes of floating rifts when the player is in creative.
The speed at which rifts close when using the rift remover, in units of rift size per tick.
The speed at which rifts grow, in units of rift size per tick.
Distance in blocks to teleport the player in front of the dimensional door.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.graphics: How long, in milliseconds, the rift's core (tesseract animation) should be shown for when attempting to place a door near a large rift but not directly on it. Set to -1 to disable.
Multiplier affecting how much rifts should jitter, 1 being the default size.
Multiplier affecting how large rifts should be rendered, 1 being the default size.
Set this to true to always show rifts' cores (tesseract animation).
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.limbo.de: Does escaping limbo cause limbo decay around the location?
When true, the world spawn of the world the player is escaping from limbo to will be used as the center of possible return location.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.limbo.es: Defines the id of the world players will spawn in upon exiting Limbo.  Leaving this blank will spawn players in the world their respawn point is in.
Defines the Y coordinate the player will spawn at when using "Escape To World"
Boolean that determines if players exiting limbo will return relative to the worldspawn instead.  If true, escapeTargetWorld has no effect.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.limbo.ha: When true, a player dying in Limbo will respawn in Limbo, making Eternal Fluid or Golden Dimensional Doors the only way to escape Limbo.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.limbo.li: The radius around a player in which blocks can decay upon exiting limbo.
Distance from spawn that limbo returns you

Defines the maximum distance out the possible return locations can be from the target center.
 Setting both return distances to 0 cause the player to exactly appear at target center.

Defines the minimum distance out the possible return locations can be from the target center.
 Setting both return distances to 0 cause the player to exactly appear at target center.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.limbo.tr: When true, the bed spawn of the player will be used as the center of possible return locations if available.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.limbo.un: When true, players are also teleported to Limbo when they die in any non-Pocket Dimension (except Limbo itself). Otherwise, players only go to Limbo if they die in a Pocket Dimension.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.limbo.wo: Defines a blacklist/whitelist of worlds that will send the player to limbo upon death.
Boolean that determines if list is a blacklist or white list for worlds.
List of the ids for worlds in the blacklsit/whitelist.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.monolith: When true, Monoliths in Limbo attack the player and deal damage.
When true, being exposed to the gaze of Monoliths for too long, will cause the player to be teleported to the void above Limbo.
Sets loading pockets to your WorldEdit clipboard asynchronous or synchronous. Only affects when WorldEdit is installed.
Can use Rift Signature in Private Pockets
If Enabled, rift signatures can be used within private pockets.
Default - Disabled but can be enabled, Default Enabled - Enabled but can be disabled, Always Enabled - Can not be disabled
Sets the equation to be used to compute weight when there is no / invalid weight equation present in the pocket generator json
Sets the fallback weight to be used if the default weight equation fails.
Sets the maximum size of any pocket. A size of x will allow for pockets up to (x + 1) * (x + 1) chunks.
Sets how many chunks apart all pockets in any pocket dimensions should be placed.
Sets the minimum size of a newly created Private Pocket. If this is set to any value bigger than maxPocketSize, the value of maxPocketSize will be used instead.
Sets the minimum size of a newly created Public Pocket. If this is set to any value bigger than privatePocketSize, the value of privatePocketSize will be used instead.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.world.cl: Dimension Blacklist for the generation of Rift Scar clusters. Add a dimension ID here to prevent generation in certain dimensions.
Sets the chance (out of 1) that a cluster of rifts will generate in a given chunk.
text.autoconfig.dimdoors.option.world.ga: Dimension Blacklist for the generation of Dimensional Portal gateways. Add a dimension ID here to prevent generation in certain dimensions.
Sets the chance (out of 1) that a dimensional gateway will generate in a given chunk.
